headline: Australian Shares and Dollar Fall as Mining Stocks Lead Sell-Off
summary: The S&P/ASX 200 lost 1.8% to hit a multi-day low as heavyweights in the mining and financial sectors sank, while the Australian dollar fell to a 10-month low of $0.6728 following Reserve Bank warnings of upside inflation risks.
why: Australia's equity index is heavily weighted toward resource extractors and commercial banks, making it sensitive to commodity demand and domestic interest rate policy.

impacts.name: S&P/ASX 200
impacts.why: A decline in commodity prices and hawkish RBA warnings weighed heavily on mining and bank shares.
